hotel_name: The Lodgers Luxury Hotel Near Golf Course Road Gurgaon

positive_snippets: It was an excellent stay overall. The staff and amenities were great—especially Suresh, who was always just a call away and extremely polite and helpful. The food was good, and the property felt very safe for couples. Cleanliness was top-notch throughout the stay. I would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay here again!

Spotless and clean, but major concerns regarding safety
​I would give The Lodgers Hotel 5 stars for cleanliness; the property is exceptionally neat and well-maintained. However, I have some serious concerns regarding security. The hotel is located in an isolated area near the highway and there is no security guard on-site, which made me feel uneasy. Additionally, there was only one staff member handling all the service. While he was helpful, the hotel needs a larger team and professional security to make guests feel truly safe.Sleeping on the mattresses was very difficult; I felt very restless all night.

Great hotel, with all facilities iron, hairdryer and 24 hour service available. Room services breakfast and staff very helpful especially Rohit we arrived very late and still no problem. I paid a small deposit before arrival to confirm booking but total all correct.
Only small drawback with location but great value for money and easy to find with Google maps. Please put hotel sign will be helpful but looks exactly like photos.
